question: The average age of 23 students of a class is 25 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 26 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of students = 23 × 25 = 575

New total (including teacher) = 24 × 26 = 624

Teacher’s age = 624 − 575 = 49

**∴ Answer = 49 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 23, Average age = 25; New average = 26 (including teacher)

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of students = 23 × 25 = 575

⇒ Total age including teacher = 24 × 26 = 624

⇒ Teacher’s age = 624 − 575 = 49

**∴ The correct answer is 49 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number ⇒ Total = Average × Number

Combined Average

When a new value is added, recompute total using new average

Quick Trick

Extra total = Difference in average × new number

Application

Teacher’s age = increase in total after inclusion
